title: Bekhorot 56 - All in the Family Herd

chapters.title: Etnan and Ma'asar Behemah
chapters.about: Status of animals given to a Zona

summary: Rabbi Hidary examines the laws of Ma'asar Behemah, specifically focusing on the status of animals that are bought or received as gifts. He explores the Gemara's derivation from Shemot regarding why such animals are exempt from the obligation, and discusses the halakhic status of partnerships and estates in relation to Ma'asar Behemah and the Kalbon surcharge.
questions: If I buy animals, am I obligated to separate Ma'asar Behemah from them?
Does the obligation of Ma'asar Behemah apply to animals bought while they are still fetuses?
Are partners in a business obligated to give Ma'asar Behemah?
What is the difference between an estate and a partnership regarding these laws?
When is an animal considered Etnan and how does that affect its status for Ma'asar Behemah?
